statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and exertional dyspnea
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries, coded as I25.10
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction, coded as Z86.73
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was billed
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is medically necessary to evaluate for potential arrhythmic etiologies contributing to these symptoms
